prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 42 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of low back strain. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported force of the crash, and the presenting symptoms align closely with that mechanism. Over the course of care the patient completed 42 visits, following a conservative and typical treatment progression that included manual therapy, targeted exercise, and home program instruction. Visit frequency tapered steadily as symptoms resolved and functional mobility returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider or documented in the available records. Billing for services rendered reflects single, appropriately sequenced charges with no repeated procedures. Patient was discharged from active care with a favorable prognosis and instructed to continue independent exercise as needed.
